headlines.title: Scandal-hit Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang quits, plunging AI chipmaking giant into turmoil
headlines.summary: US lawmakers now want to question him over whether one of his alleged relationships was with a Chinese spy.

headlines.title: Mercedes-Benz halts new investment in German plants, considers closures
headlines.summary: The Stuttgart carmaker is temporarily halting all further investment at its German sites. Possible plant closures are looming, increasing pressure on staff, works council and IG Metall. Volkswagen and Audi have also announced major savings programmes.

headlines.summary: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

headlines.title: Not even old Andalusian heartlands can save Pedro Sánchez
headlines.summary: Spain’s most populous region powered the Socialists for decades, but the politics of the south are changing.

headlines.title: Microsoft struggling to restore service as global outage affects Outlook and Teams
headlines.summary: Services including Teams, Outlook and Microsoft's AI software Copilot have been affected by "connectivity problems".

headlines.title: Nvidia board weighs Jensen Huang’s future as reports emerge of second affair
headlines.summary: The report of a second affair follows Huang admitting to having a relationship with Alice Huang, a senior executive at Singapore-based data centre company Megaspeed.

headlines.title: Is AIIB s complaint mechanism failing affected communities?
headlines.summary: The Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank has a grievance redress mechanism for people affected by projects it finances. But those seeking to file a complaint face significant hurdles. Critics say reforms are needed.

headlines.title: AI and Ukraine to dominate EU leaders talks — live updates
headlines.summary: Government chiefs meet in Dublin as arguments persist over who represents Europe in peace talks.

headlines.title: The rise of 'housefishing' - when does using AI go from enhancing to misleading?
headlines.summary: Experts warn that using AI to enhance property images can go too far and mislead prospective buyers.

headlines.title: OpenAI reports steep losses despite quarterly revenue rise
headlines.summary: OpenAI's quarterly revenue rose about 50% to $10 billion in the third quarter. However, the group behind ChatGPT continued to ‌post steep operating losses, according to the Wall Street Journal.

headlines.title: Megaspeed and the battle to go high-end Nvidia chips into China
headlines.summary: Jensen Huang s affair with a suspected Chinese spy has shone a light on Megaspeed, the company she worked for. It is under investigation in the US for smuggling Nvidia chips into China, which it denies.

headlines.title: Burnham to discuss ‘problem’ Chinese imports in final days of Brexit reset talks
headlines.summary: The British prime minister said there will be "long nights ahead" as he finalizes a reset deal with Brussels.

headlines.title: Who is Nvidia's interim CEO Colette Kress - and who could take over permanently?
headlines.summary: Chief financial officer Colette Kress in in charge of Nvidia for now, but several others are in the frame as potential successors.

headlines.title: New aviation deals raise flight limits between China and Central Asia
headlines.summary: Uzbekistan and Kazakhstan agreed to higher weekly flight limits with Beijing, while a separate agreement allows more services between Tashkent, Almaty and Astana. Airlines are also exploring new regional routes, although rising operating costs remain a concern.

headlines.title: Why Nvidia CEO s affair with alleged Chinese spy matters for AI race
headlines.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has apologized for an affair with a woman the US believes was spying for China. The story could have profound implications for the world s most valuable company and the global AI race.

headlines.title: Putin open to Europe joining Ukraine peace talks, says Witkoff
headlines.summary: Donald Trump's envoys debriefed Ukrainian leader in Dublin late Thursday after Moscow discussions.

headlines.summary: The UK is seeing impressive growth, but will it last?

headlines.title: Inside Anthropic’s blockbuster IPO: What we know about the AI giant’s plans
headlines.summary: Anthropic plans to raise up to $64 billion (€57.1bn) in its upcoming initial public offering, the artificial intelligence giant said in a filing on Tuesday, in a listing that could value the company at up to $1.4 trillion (€1.25trn).

headlines.title: Climate science says 1.5C is dead. No one wants to bury it.
headlines.summary: Leaders at COP31 want to keep the totemic goal alive, even after the U.N. declared it impossible to hit.

headlines.title: UK economy grows at fastest rate for more than two years
headlines.summary: ﻿The UK economy grew by 0.7% in the three months to September, according to official figures.

summary: 독일 자동차 산업의 구조적 침체 속에서 메르세데스-벤츠가 독일 내 공장 신규 투자를 중단하고 폐쇄 가능성을 검토하며 제조업 경쟁력 악화 우려가 심화되고 있습니다. 폭스바겐과 아우디 역시 대규모 비용 절감 프로그램을 가동하며 유로존 핵심 국가의 경기 둔화 압박을 높이고 있습니다.
key_points: 메르세데스-벤츠, 독일 내 공장 신규 투자 일시 중단 및 구조조정·폐쇄 검토
